title: EU SST – Horizon Scanning study – New orbits
description: Space beyond the Earth's orbits is becoming increasingly relevant, for instance for planetary research, solar observation or commercial purposes. There are also new opportunities to utilise locations and orbits for observing space objects orbiting the Earth; more specifically, this concerns locations on other celestial bodies and the corresponding orbits (e.g. lunar and cis-lunar), as well as the Lagrange points and perhaps other positions in space. The benefits, challenges and opportunities associated with the various aspects of this development will be identified and discussed within this study, which will also look at these new locations and orbits with a view to identify possible scenarios for long-term development and exploitation; thus, the potential impact on the EU SST system and mandate shall be examined.
